_about: How names and recurring terms are written in this language. Every translation follows this file, so a name is always spelled the same way. Names are written by sound, never translated (the author's rule). The spellings here are first versions based on the written names: the author's own pronunciation is recorded in Legacy/Behind The Scenes/World Lore/Word Pronunciation/Unique Words Pronounciation.wav, so correct any spelling here and later translations will follow it. Add new names the first time they are translated.
rule: Story names stay exactly as in English, as in Portuguese, Spanish and Malay. That includes coined world terms written as names: creatures, plants, items, nari gels, spells, factions, guilds, places, ranks and coins (Wood People, Sand Worms, Fost Stone, Nari Refresher, Red Winga, Sapphire, Pearl, Buhraies Plains, Nari Caverns, Bone Wood). Plain words around them are translated into Indonesian (nari gel stays, 'soul energy' becomes 'energi jiwa'), following Indonesian word order (Kerajaan Sanbi, Pengawal Forway). Exception: the currency balls is written bola (no plural marking; bola-bola only for emphasis); the rank follows it (bola Sapphire, bola Pearl). Faction names like Beer Balls stay as they are. Standard Indonesian (KBBI/EYD spelling). Many of these translations were adapted from the Malay ones, so the two read alike, but the wording is Indonesian, not Malaysian (Anda/kamu, bisa, karena, kota, desa).
